name: Goodwen
description: Use AI agents to ask focused questions, collect human responses, and build traceable evidence for decisions.
description_zh: AI 评估与决策工作流：依据选定资料提问，收集真人回答，分析差异并追溯依据，支持需求调研、供应商评估、招聘与培训测评。
description_en: Use AI agents to ask focused questions, collect human responses, and build traceable evidence for decisions.

mcp_oauth.scopes: offline_access packs:read questionnaires:read questionnaires:write distributions:write invitations:read results:read attention:read grading:propose results:write events:subscribe participant_materials:read participant_profiles:write

examples_zh: 根据这些产品资料设计一份客户需求调研，先交给我审核。
比较这些供应商的回答，列出需求差异、缺失证据和下一轮追问。
对照岗位要求和这份答卷，整理面试中需要进一步核实的问题。
按照已确认的评分标准评阅这些培训答卷，保存评分建议并指出薄弱点。
examples_en: Create a customer needs questionnaire from these product materials and give me the draft to review.
Compare these suppliers' responses and list differences, missing evidence, and follow-up questions.
Use the job requirements and this response to prepare questions for the interview.
Assess these training responses against the approved rubric and save grading suggestions with answer evidence.
